text:
julia: quick heads-up - morning deploys hitting admission rejects in staging: cosign verify failing + audit logs show KMS permission denied for signer SA.

omar: any recent key rotations or ops-sync runs?

ci-bot: AuditEvent: KMSKeyRotation actor=infra-admin@redwood time=2026-04-05T01:04:12Z key=container-signer

audit-bot: AuditEvent: IAMPolicyChange actor=ops-sync@redwood time=2026-04-05T01:05:02Z change=removed roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner from serviceAccount:cosign@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com

julia: that explains it. runtime blocked images in canary, fallback to previous tag prevented broader impact.

images-team: suggested step: (1) re-add IAM binding, (2) run attest job for affected digests, (3) if signatures referenced old destroyed key version -> rebuild and sign via pipeline.

omar: gcloud command to rebind: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/container/cryptoKeys/signer \\
  --member="serviceAccount:cosign@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \\
  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner"
```

sre-oncall: do we have a rollback plan?

julia: yes canary remains pinned; revert list ready.

ci-bot: ActionLog: iam_binding_added actor=omar@redwood target=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/container/cryptoKeys/signer time=2026-04-05T02:12:30Z

omar: binding restored and attest re-run; verification passes for 4 digests. opening PR to add an ops-sync exclusion for cosign SA and a CI preflight to check KMS bindings before rotation (https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/905).

julia: great. follow-ups: add IAM-drift alert, ensure attest upload is validated in CI, and add a short playbook entry: if KMS perms removed -> restore binding, re-run attest, do not relax admission gates.

images-team: queued rebuild for one artifact signed with old destroyed key; pipeline will handle sign via KMS URI: ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/container/cryptoKeys/signer

sre-oncall: monitoring canary for 30m. no customer impact.

julia: thanks all :thumbsup:
